annotations.text:
PB-48 — MotifPath app shell, componentized + mobile.
Main (desktop) and MobileMain (phone) run the same click-driven flow through the same AppBar and Authoring components — AppBar takes a compact prop that swaps inline nav for a hamburger + nav-only drawer, everything else (theme toggle, Save, avatar) stays in one top bar on both widths, matching desktop. Theme toggle is one plain visible icon, one place — no account-menu detour. Authoring is the same component on desktop and mobile; it adapts via CSS media queries (stacked layout, single top bar, no fixed sidebar) rather than a separate mobile build or a scroll-sideways hack. My path / Lesson / Practice / Exercises content is centered (max-width 760, margin auto) rather than pinned left on the wide desktop frame. The old static Mobile/StickyBehavior artboards stay as isolated reference for the hamburger + sticky concepts in Direction B before this rebuild.
These three are components, not standalone screens — Main and MobileMain both import them. Listed here because the canvas format requires every imported file to have its own spot.

ExerciseView renders one exercise (prompt + answer surface) with no idea which option is "correct" — that data is never passed in. Authoring's preview modal and the real Practice screen both mount it, so a preview can't show something the student won't actually see.
